messages:
incident-bot: [pager] P1 — elevated 5xx rate at ingress-eu-west-1: widespread TLS handshake failures impacting /v1/generate. Threshold breached: 120/min. Paging oncall @sre. link: https://pager/redwood/incident/2371112222
Alex: oncall ack. jumping in — grabbing traces and proxy logs. Morgan, can you tail the edge proxy logs for eu-west?
Morgan: tailing now. Seeing a sharp cluster of `tls: bad certificate` and `client hello timeout` entries starting ~02:10 UTC. Count: ~1.1k errors in 4m. Screenshot + logs: https://grafana/redwood/d/ingress/handshake-errors?from=now-10m
sre-bot: alert rule: ingress_tls_handshakes > 50/min for 5m — severity P1. Runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/ingress-tls-rotations
Priya: quick check: `openssl s_client -connect ingress-eu-west-1:443 -servername api.redwood.com` returns leaf cert expired at Jun 12 02:09:58 2025 GMT. Looks like rotation didn't finish.
Alex: I can confirm; connecting from debug jump host shows expiry just before the alert. Subject CN=ingress-eu-west.api.redwood.com.
Jordan: rotator logs show push failure at 02:07 with `403 Forbidden: token invalid` when calling edge-keys. Rotator retried but backed off and didn't push before expiry. Snippet from rotator log:
```
ERROR rotator: upload cert failed status=403 body="permission denied"
  at rotator/service.go:212
  at rotator/main.go:88
```
Dave: immediate mitigations: (A) manually upload the cert bundle to edge-keys and reload ingress; (B) temporarily shift traffic away from eu-west; (C) if old cert still valid somewhere, revert — but likely expired. I'd do A + partial steering if upload takes >2m.
Sylvia: impact: support channel has multiple timeout reports from EU customers; error pages show 502/504. CS notified. Recommend short incident banner and customer notice.
Priya: I located the generated certificate in vault: `vault://secrets/ingress/eu/leaf-2025-06-12.pem` — rotator created it but failed to upload. OCSP responder is reachable from edge nodes.
Alex: Jordan — can you try a manual upload using the rotator service account token? Command I use below:
```
curl -s -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer ${ROTATOR_SA_TOKEN}" \
  -F "cert=@leaf.pem" https://edge-keys.internal/api/v1/certs/upload
# then restart ingress pods one-at-a-time
kubectl -n edge-eu rollout restart deployment/ingress-proxy --timeout=60s
```
Jordan: starting manual upload now. uploading... got HTTP/1.1 200 OK. Triggering rolling restart (maxUnavailable=1). Will wait 30s between pods.
Morgan: first pod restarted, handshake error rate dropped ~60% in that wave. we're still seeing some client hello timeouts from long-lived connections.
Dave: good. Also verify OCSP staple is present after reload. If stapling fails some clients will still see handshake errors.
Alex: post-restart check from jump host: `openssl s_client -connect ingress-eu-west-1:443 -servername api.redwood.com -status` shows new cert valid until Jul 12 02:09:57 2025 GMT and OCSP response stapled.
Sylvia: CS update posted. No large accounts fully down; several users saw short failures. Drafted customer-facing message, tagging ops-cs for review.
Priya: preliminary root cause: rotator service token expired during rotation window and the refresh race caused a 403 from edge-keys. Also the rotator's retry/backoff logic deferred retries past the expiry boundary. I'll open an infra ticket to: 1) fix token refresh race 2) tighten retry policy for pre-expiry pushes 3) add a pre-rotation verification step to ensure upload succeeds at least N minutes before expiry.
Jordan: ingress is back to normal. 5xx rate down to baseline over the last 7m. Dash: https://grafana/redwood/d/ingress/overview?from=now-15m
sre-bot: ingress_tls_handshakes < threshold for 6m. Auto-close timer set for 10m.
Dave: post-incident actions: Priya owns rotator fix, Jordan owns deployment validation + runbook changes, Alex documents oncall steps and adds a synthetic pre-expiry check. Postmortem owners assigned.
Morgan: logs still show a handful of `tls: client hello timeout` entries from NATed clients — likely clients reusing stale sockets. No further pages.
Alex: handover notes for next oncall: keep an eye on rotator upload success metric and the new pre-expiry synthetic. Ticket IDs: INFRA-4821 (rotator token fix), INFRA-4822 (retry/backoff), DOCS-310 (runbook update).
Sylvia: CS will follow up with customers in the incident window (02:07-02:18 UTC). I'll coordinate final messaging with legal.
incident-bot: incident marked: mitigated. Monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
Alex: will close thread when 15m stable. Thanks team for quick triage and manual push. :thumbsup:
